verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented way for a developer to choose premium residential or datacenter proxies. The README line about "no proxy headaches" is a general reliability claim, not a documented proxy-selection feature. One community comment also states Firecrawl lacks a proxy service, so this applicable anti-bot axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use premium residential or datacenter proxies to bypass sites that are hard to scrape
